name: Valentine Theatre building (1895, E.O. Fallis), 410 Adams St
notes: Six storeys of tan brick: stone-trimmed storefront base with pilasters and a transom band, belt course, regular paired windows, smaller top-floor windows under a deep bracketed cornice. The theatre's fly loft (LiDAR 33 m) sits behind; the street block is capped at its real ~25 m.
